outcome: Changes in ventilatory needs during pregnancy, delivery, and postpartum
cohort: 10 women with CCHS with current or prior pregnancy (7 women with pre-existing CCHS diagnosis reporting on 10 pregnancies)
finding: Women with CCHS may experience changes in their ventilatory needs during pregnancy, highlighting the importance of monitoring and adjusting ventilatory support.
mod_finding: Two patients using diaphragm pacing reported discomfort during late pregnancy or after cesarean delivery, leading to discontinuation and in one case, respiratory arrest.
gest_age: Mentioned in relation to discomfort with diaphragm pacing but specific values not provided.
